evals.prompt: Release a new version of this package to JSR
evals.expected_output: The agent runs ./scripts/release.sh --yes from the repo root, reports the quality gate results, the assessed semver bump, and the new tag name.

evals.prompt: I want to bump the version and publish this package to JSR. We've added a few new features since the last tag.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs ./scripts/release.sh --yes, the script assesses a minor bump from the feat: commits, and pushes the new tag.

evals.prompt: Check if the package is ready to release, then cut a new tag
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the release script which discovers available deno tasks, runs format check, lint, tests, and JSR dry-run before creating and pushing the tag.
